description: Conteo Ciclovia is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Intendencia de Montevideo. El sistema de conteo automático de bicicletas implementado en una intersección urbana se basa en redes neuronales convolucionales (CNNs) optimizadas mediante el algoritmo YOLO (You Only Look Once), lo que permite la detección y el seguimiento en tiempo real. Coverage: Intendencia de Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Intendencia de Montevideo. Its tags are Harvest. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
